item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 09/Dec/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will bring generally fine weather to southern China for the rest of this week. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large over the region. A broad band of clouds is expected to cover the northeastern part of the South China Sea early to midweek next week. Meanwhile, under the influence of a replenishment of the intense northeast monsoon, temperatures over southern China will fall progressively and it will be rather cool over the coast. Besides, a broad area of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the seas east of the Philippines in the next couple of days.
